_readme: Remote config for the mobile app's bottom ad banner. The app fetches
this in the background on launch and falls back to a bundled copy of
the same content when it can't. Contract (version 1):
banner.id       stable id for the promotion; dismissals are stored
against it, so CHANGE THE ID to resurface the banner
for people who dismissed the previous one.
banner.message  short pitch, <= 200 chars, rendered on two lines max.
banner.url      https only; anything else is rejected client-side.
banner.enabled  set false (or drop the banner object) to hide the
banner in every app within a day of launch cadence.
Bump 'version' only for breaking schema changes: older apps hide the
banner entirely when they see a version they don't understand.
Keep this file in sync with AdBanner.fallback in the mobile repo

banner.message: Cloud-dead smart devices sell for cheap. Grab one and liberate it.
